name: What energy-efficient features should I look for in new bedroom windows?

mainEntity.name: What energy-efficient features should I look for in new bedroom windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: For improved energy efficiency, look for features such as Low-E (low-emissivity) glass coatings, which reflect heat while allowing light in. Argon or krypton gas fills between glass panes provide better insulation than air. Double or triple-pane glazing also significantly reduces heat transfer. The U-factor, Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC), and air leakage ratings are important metrics to consider, indicating how well a window insulates and blocks solar heat.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key energy-efficient features include Low-E glass, argon/krypton gas fills, and multiple panes. Check U-factor and SHGC ratings.
